summary: Cattaraugus County, NY tower built 1928 on Mount Irvine, moved to Science Hill in 1931 or 1932 and later reassembled at a school in Ellicottville; sources disagree on the move and reassembly years.

facts.agency: New York Conservation Department, Division of State Parks (original builder)
facts.status_note: Tower moved to the Ellicottville CTE School; the Science Hill site is listed as gone and no source read describes what remains there

events.note: Built on Mount Irvine in Allegany State Park by the Division of State Parks
Moved by the Park from Mount Irvine to Science Hill. EverybodyWiki gives 1932; the chapter list says the move came three years after the 1928 erection, which would be 1931
Taken down by Park personnel and reassembled by an Ellicottville BOCES class at the school. Hamilton College dates the move to the early 1970s instead

notes_for_editor: Two accounts of the move to Ellicottville: the chapter list and EverybodyWiki say 1978; Hamilton College says the early 1970s and cites a 2005 webpage. The Hamilton text does not name Science Hill, so it may mean a different park tower. The chapter list and EverybodyWiki both give 1928 for the erection on Mount Irvine. The chapter list says the move to Science Hill came three years after the erection, which implies 1931; EverybodyWiki gives 1932 for the move. Not settled. The current school name (Ellicottville CTE School) and the older BOCES school name are not explicitly tied together by any source read. The existing record's access level 'permission' is not supported by a source read, so no access fact is written. The 'relocated' events for the school move in the record use no year; this record gives 1978 with the disagreement noted.
